#flux: -n 1

# Note: PBS -q directive (main@gusched01) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Queue selection not preserved. Job may run on different queue/priority.
# Note: PBS -l mem directive (50GB) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Memory limits not enforced. Job may be killed if exceeding node memory.
# Note: PBS ngpus=1 does not translate to Flux batch script directives.
# You may need to use 'flux mini submit -g 1' or '--gpus-per-node=1' at submission time.
# Performance consideration: GPU allocation not specified in batch script. Job may not have access to GPUs.
# Note: Commented PBS gpu_type=a100 would specify GPU type, but has no Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: GPU type constraint not preserved.

module purge
module load ncarenv/22.12
module load nvhpc/22.11
module load cuda
module load craype
module load cray-mpich
module load ncarcompilers
module load cray-libsci
module list

make clean
make
"
